name: com.kruty1918.atmos
description: Procedural skybox palettes and lightweight stylized shaders for calm casual games: gradient sky with sun and stars, foliage vertex sway, procedural campfire flames, glow and flicker light. Includes a Sky Designer editor window, data-driven SkySpec presets, smooth sky transitions and a one-call campfire builder.

samples.description: Ready-made SkySpec JSON presets (day, evening, night) and code snippets showing Sky.Apply, SkyController transitions, FoliageSway and Campfire usage.
